summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.1 Non-right Triangles: Law of Sines: Use the Law of Sines to solve oblique triangles.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "10.1 Non-right Triangles: Law of Sines", prints these objectives: "Use the Law of Sines to solve oblique triangles." "Find the area of an oblique triangle using the sine function." "Solve applied problems using the Law of Sines.". The section text says: "To ensure the safety of over 5,000 U.S. aircraft flying simultaneously during peak times, air traffic controllers monitor and communicate with them after receiving data from the robust radar beacon system. Suppose two radar stations located 20 miles apart each detect an aircraft between them. The angle of elevation measured by the first station is 35 degrees, whereas the angle of elevation measured by the second station is 15 degrees. How can we determine the altitude of the aircraft? We see in…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
